salesFlow.title: Sales Flow
salesFlow.bothFlow: Opportunity shows both "To Quotation" and "To Order" actions
salesFlow.standardDesc: For large orders requiring formal quotation and competitive bidding. All orders must come from quotations.
salesFlow.simpleDesc: For repeat customers and small orders without quotation. Opportunity can convert directly to order, but must link an opportunity.
salesFlow.bothDesc: Default recommended. Sales reps can choose standard or simple flow per case, offering maximum flexibility.
salesFlow.tipStandard: Standard Flow: All orders must be converted from quotations. The opportunity "More" menu only shows "To Quotation".
salesFlow.tipSimple: Simple Flow: Opportunity can convert directly to order. The "Related Quotation" field is hidden in order form, and "Related Opportunity" becomes required.
salesFlow.tipBoth: Both Allowed: The opportunity "More" menu shows both "To Quotation" and "To Order". Sales reps decide per case.
salesFlow.tipGeneral: Configuration changes do not affect existing data. Validation only applies to new/converted records.
